headline: LAA @ CLE matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAA 3.92 at CLE 4.25, with a projected total of 8.18. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (LAA -0.25, CLE -0.27), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -0.52, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -23.2%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Walbert Ureña has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Nolan Schanuel, Chase DeLauter, Jo Adell, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Rhys Hoskins, Josh Lowe because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
